concept.title: Babies, children and parents
concept.shortdesc: Babies, toddlers, pre-school and school-age children and young people, and the parents who bring them.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Babies, toddlers and children before school age, and their parents or early years settings.
: Children and young people up to about 18, in broad age ranges, plus some disadvantaged or at-risk young people.
: Babies and toddlers, up to about school entry, and the mums who bring them.
: Children of primary school age or attending a particular school, and some at nursery age leading up to school.
: Parents, carers or grandparents looking after a baby, toddler or pre-schooler (roughly birth to 4 years), usually attending together with the child.
